gen-gf-luxurious-roman-gf-padyakke-expan: Luxurious Roman flaunts open terminals and a loud display swagger, with strokes that vary in weight, while Padyakke Expanded One spreads out below in flat, wide serif rounds. One shouts, the other drawls.
gen-gf-luxurious-roman-gf-stint-ultra-ex: Luxurious Roman brings expressive, thick-and-thin display letters with open terminals to the top. And Stint Ultra Expanded, a serif of thread-thin curves floating apart, gives the pair its airiness.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-archivo: Graceful and casual, LXGW WenKai TC looks drawn by a fixed-width nib, every round letter open-handed. But Archivo, a sans-serif with a commanding x-height, would carry a longer passage in a firm, editorial voice.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-asap: LXGW WenKai TC writes with a constant, neon-tube stroke and open-handed curves, a casual hand that never presses harder. Asap, a sans, keeps things readable beneath it.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-bespoke-serif: A pen that never shifts its pressure gives LXGW WenKai TC its casual, even-lined hand. Bespoke Serif, a classic serif with thin strokes about half the weight of its thick ones, would feel dignified and authoritative over a longer passage.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-epilogue: LXGW WenKai TC lays down graceful, pen-and-paper curves in a moderate lowercase height. Epilogue, a sans-serif with a tall-bodied, wire-like monoline skeleton, would read as approachable and contemporary across a longer passage.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-erode: Erode has a tall middle band and shallow ascenders. Its text serif ebb and flow of stroke weight makes a dignified, editorial partner for the casual handwriting of LXGW WenKai TC.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads clean and professional, its sans-serif s curves opening wide with no thick-thin shift and a generous x-height. But LXGW WenKai TC does the graceful, casual handwriting, while Fira Sans does the steady lifting.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-public-sans: A pen that never changes pressure or angle defines LXGW WenKai TC. Public Sans, a sans with a hefty lowercase and broad open counters on c and s, reads trustworthy and sturdy over a longer stretch.
gen-gf-lxgw-wenkai-tc-fs-supreme: Graceful handwriting from LXGW WenKai TC, with no thick-thin shift, like a steel cable outline, sits above the page. Supreme, a crisp sans-serif with a heavy-looking strip of text and letters held open, grounds it.
